title: Leader Election

searches.query: "Leader Election" system design interview split brain quorum
searches.result: success; exact-concept search executed, but independent frequency/rank/company evidence was insufficient; prompts are original production adaptations and technical decisions use checked primary sources

sources.title: Ongaro and Ousterhout: Raft extended paper
sources.supportRationale: Terms, persistent votes, election/log safety and membership assumptions in the original Raft protocol.

sources.title: etcd v3.6: API guarantees
sources.supportRationale: Explicit v3.6 KV consistency, weaker serializable read option, watch limitations and lease behavior.

sources.title: Martin Kleppmann: How to do distributed locking
sources.supportRationale: Original analysis of paused lease holders and resource-enforced fencing; not a blanket evaluation of every current Redis deployment.

sources.title: Google SRE: Handling overload
sources.supportRationale: Capacity, bounded queues, load shedding and retry-aware overload reasoning.

sources.title: Amazon Builders’ Library: Timeouts, retries and backoff with jitter
sources.supportRationale: Timeout uncertainty, safe repeated effects, retry amplification, bounded retries and jitter; URL redirects to the author's AWS Builder Center article.

scenarios.theme: The old leader resumes after a long pause. What stops its writes?
scenarios.assumptions: A new leader was elected and workers already accepted a newer ownership epoch. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Leader Election to old still runs.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: The old leader resumes after a long pause. What stops its writes?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Require worker/storage mutations to validate the relevant epoch atomically and reject obsolete generations

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: This requires resource cooperation and durable generation handling

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Killing the old process is useful defense but not sufficient for delayed packets; unsupported external effects may need redesign.

evidence.rationale: Primary support mapped to raft, fencing; interview frequency is not claimed.

full-delivery.rationale: Three labeled parts are self-contained; native disclosure and host confidence integration use stable keys.

scenarios.theme: Leaders change every few seconds under load. Shorten the timeout?
scenarios.assumptions: Process scheduling delays and network tails grow during peak demand. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: Leaders change every few seconds under load. Shorten the timeout?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Longer timeouts can delay legitimate failover

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Separate detection-speed objectives from safety; a timeout does not prove death or fix overloaded coordination storage.

scenarios.theme: A leader sends a bank transfer and loses leadership before reply. Reissue?
scenarios.assumptions: The bank cannot validate your election term and the transfer might have completed. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Leader Election to external task.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A leader sends a bank transfer and loses leadership before reply. Reissue?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Use the bank’s supported stable intent/idempotency/status mechanism and durable workflow identity, reconciling the original outcome

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Provider cooperation and retained intent state are required

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Election orders your control plane, but cannot by itself guarantee exactly-once effects in an unrelated system.
